scientific_integrity: The asserted finding is a globally sharp placement optimization for a fixed inventory of slow site clocks, not the classical general-period diffusion formula. Corrector derivation and equality analysis included; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite periodic nearest-neighbor continuous-time one-particle walk, shared nonzero bias and strictly positive two-value site resistances; no arbitrary multivalue profiles or general graph claims.
title: Balanced slow sites minimize diffusion in a biased periodic hopping chain
